title: A batch gate held for timing out twice retries on its own
description: Runs the real gate over ports whose clock the case controls: a timeout hold an older loop wrote clears on the next gate run, which reruns main's tip and verifies it without waiting out any cool-off (GY-3444), master status attention names the hold and its reason while it stands, and a gate held for a failing case still waits for main to move.

steps.name: a timeout hold retries its tip; a failing-case hold waits for main
